description: Preview the cost to download a court filing PDF. Identify the entry with simple_name and item_number. Does not pull the document and does not charge. Cost is $0 if already purchased, or if the PDF is already in our library and the plan has flagFreeLibrary. Free-page allowances (if any) come from plan limitDocuments and apply to billable pulls. Returns simpleName, item_number, page_count, chargeable_pages, cost, plan_limit_documents, pages_used_this_period, free_pages_remaining, document_in_library, and already_owned.

docket_id.description: Optional. A docket entry id already known to the caller. Responses identify filings by simpleName and item_number instead.

item_number.description: Docket item number (e.g. 1 for the petition). Use with simple_name.

name: get_document_cost_tool
title: Preview court document cost
